html:
Given n >= 0 pairs, return all balanced parenthesis strings in lexicographic order. For n=0 return [""].

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    2
  ],
  "expected": [
    "(())",
    "()()"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    0
  ],
  "expected": [
    ""
  ]
}
Hint

Never close more parentheses than have been opened.

Complexity: O(n*C_n) time and output for n>0, where C_n is the nth Catalan number
